summary: This P&ID illustrates the Gas Treatment System, specifically focusing on the Scrubber Pump 24-PA001 and its associated piping, instrumentation, and controls. The pump handles liquid from a wet gas scrubber, moving it towards condensate export or a sample receiver, with a dedicated seal flush system and minimum flow recirculation.
main_hazards: Overpressure (indicated by various pressure instruments and setpoints)
Loss of Containment (due to pump and piping handling process fluids)
Loss of Liquid Seal for 24-PA001 (explicitly noted as an alarm condition)
Pump damage due to low flow/cavitation (implied by minimum flow line and valve setting)
Hydrocarbon release (as part of a gas treatment system, from a wet gas scrubber)
